news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.04 (vs ₹0.06 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.04 (up from ₹0.06 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹111.6m (up 5.1% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.97m (up ₹12.4m from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.5% (up from net loss in 3Q 2025). The move to profitability was primarily driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 10 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.03 (vs ₹0.34 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.03 (up from ₹0.34 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹128.2m (down 1.9% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.58m (up ₹33.9m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 2.8% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025). The move to profitability was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 60% per year and the company’s share price has also fallen by 60% per year.
